rationale: Record teaching the baked C++ lowering lane about combo_box, which its widget switch omitted while the runtime materializer handled it, so an imported dropdown baked as a bare View that rendered and did nothing. The option list moves onto the shared ImportedWidgetSemantics so both lowerers read one field, and the emitter switch becomes exhaustive over NativeWidgetKind. Watch-only: no design-import or rendering authority is transferred, and no existing kind changes behavior.
tests: generate_pulp_cpp bakes a dropdown as a ComboBox, not a bare View
